# The Provider System

> Texas-first digital systems agency for service businesses. Remote engagements are available nationwide.

The Provider System is owned and led by John W Johnson. It designs websites, CRM and job operations, automation, practical AI customer systems, content workflows, and selected custom software around the way a service business actually works.

The public site makes no promise of rankings, lead volume, revenue, savings, or perfect AI accuracy. Project stories describe observable delivered scope. Ownership, account access, third-party services, support, and handoff are defined by the project agreement.

## Primary routes

- `/` — Texas-first homepage and system overview
- `/services` — complete service map
- `/industries` — operating guides for priority service industries
- `/texas` — statewide position and evidence-led regional hubs
- `/work` — real project archive and safe screenshot previews
- `/playbooks` — 15 practical owner guides
- `/process` — assess, design, build, launch, and handoff process
- `/about` — founder and operating principles
- `/start` — project inquiry and system-review form
- `/faq` — project, ownership, AI, and delivery questions

## Texas coverage

Texas is the primary market focus. The project record represented on this site includes work connected to Abilene, San Angelo, Anson, the Big Country, the Permian Basin, Lubbock, Midland, Odessa, and broader West Texas service markets.

Regional routes:

- `/texas/abilene-big-country`
- `/texas/san-angelo-concho-valley`
- `/texas/lubbock`
- `/texas/midland-odessa`

These are service and project markets, not claimed Provider System office locations.

## Selected project records

- Total Quality Plumbing — Abilene plumbing and local website architecture
- Weathersbee Electric Co. — San Angelo industrial electrical website
- Roller Rink USA — San Angelo party and event booking experience
- Adrian's Custom Services — Anson and Big Country contractor website
- Mansfield Mining — West Texas and Permian Basin industrial website
- Master Commercial Clean — multi-market West Texas commercial service website
- Abilene Commercial — commercial property platform
- FlowOS — booking, queue, CRM, and operations product
- The Offer Hero — producer pipeline and workflow product

Project previews are static screenshots by default. Live client sites open separately so client frame-security policies and third-party scripts are not bypassed.
